rationale: Post-evaluation AI correction of the shared-scope loss identified in fam-names-03-u03. Merge the permission and its detached time/travel trigger into a single permission grounded in the complete d(1) paragraph. The older material-name-change, DS-11, and unchanged-ID branch now appears in the summary alongside insufficient time before urgent or emergency travel. The suspension requirement and its older-change trigger remain separate current claims. No issuing actor or passport validity duration is invented. Both former revisions and their assertions remain in history; this flat review format preserves the full branch as text, not executable conditional logic.

replacements.summary: For an applicant whose material name change occurred more than one year before applying on form DS-11 and whose ID has not been updated to reflect that change, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name if there is insufficient time to request acceptable ID before urgent or emergency travel.
replacements.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name. If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;
